task: D3 bounded grouped NF4 expert compute
scope: Development candidate: bounded grouped NF4 restore and restricted hybrid grouped GEMM. Formal performance, end-to-end gate and D3 acceptance remain open.

candidate_recipe.routing: ascending active expert IDs, group width 1/2/4; original activation, route weighting and scatter order
candidate_recipe.reference_math: Caller explicitly selects cuBLASLt and BF16 reduced_precision/split_k=(False, False), identically in A/B and resident/streamed controls. Runtime refuses other settings and never changes them itself.
candidate_recipe.small_rows: 0 rows: no operation. 1 through 16 rows: explicit native torch.mm out path. More than 16: cublasGemmGroupedBatchedEx. This is an intentionally hybrid candidate, not all-expert GEMM fusion.
candidate_recipe.memory: 64 MiB expert-weight arena; separate 4 MiB cuBLAS workspace; 64 MiB per-call outputs/pointers; conservative 256 MiB activation/routing tensor budget. These are not total VRAM or allocator-reservation bounds.
candidate_recipe.scope_limit: No claim of bit-exact substitution under the old default cuBLAS dispatch, no unvalidated geometry, no public trainer/default or backward integration. Retain the unsuccessful group-all and one-row-only diagnostics.

hardware.end_to_end: Linux Ampere or newer, at least 16 GB GPU memory (decimal minimum used by preflight) and enough RAM/checkpoint storage; RTX 3090 24 GB is one option
hardware.disk_claim: Local checkpoint/shards only; no cold-SSD throughput or striping claim
hardware.current_rental_action: none; prepare and pass local controls before booking a GPU window

references: unchanged B1.2 sequential eager code with the same explicit cuBLASLt/no-split-K policy
independent resident weights from identical stored bytes
resident and streamed controls with identical new compute class/backend
same grouped primitive with group width 1
correctness_matrix.numerics: torch.equal outputs, dtype/shape identity, finite values and nonzero positive controls; no tolerance substitution
correctness_matrix.negative_control: Change the down weights of an active expert in the same process; output must differ. Empty routing is a separate no-load control, not a negative-control PASS.
correctness_matrix.memory: Explicit group weight arena includes all packed/dense/sidecar/code/scratch/padding bytes; also measure total allocated and reserved peaks with resident reference released.
correctness_matrix.ownership: Retain every slot until compute finishes; refuse insufficient budgets before reads or allocation, concurrent leases and unsupported cases; close on errors.
correctness_matrix.ordering: One fetch per active expert, no fetch for empty experts; deterministic expert order, identical routing weights and accumulation order. Never materialize a dense stack of all experts.

prospective_performance_design.gate: Do not time a candidate that fails exactness, negative controls, ownership or memory controls
prospective_performance_design.meaning: A=unchanged B1.2, B=bounded candidate, identical source weights/inputs/routes/precision; one child process per arm
prospective_performance_design.initial_fixed_budget: Proposal: width 4, pinned trained layer 7, all three formats. Five ABBA pilot blocks per configuration under ADR 0003, then its deterministic additions with a ten-block cap per configuration. Zero replacement blocks: any invalid arm stops that configuration and is retained. N beyond the cap means insufficient precision, not success. Freeze the final counts/rules before execution.
metrics: exported CUDA kernel count and raw trace
versions, SM clocks, temperature, power and visible peers
prospective_performance_design.profiling: Separate warm profiling invocation with identical workload; require real CUDA kernel events. CPU operator counts and missing CUPTI never certify fewer GPU launches.
prospective_performance_design.success_rule: Not frozen. Record all samples and position-matched ratios; choose numeric speed/memory/launch thresholds and complete F1 validity rows before execution, without looking at formal arms.
